question: At the strongest tested1024/B4096 fixed48 configuration, does selecting another preempted request improve whole-request service? Is any gain explained by first-fit alone?
workload: Same1024 GSM8K development requests in source order, all arrivals at zero, same Q0 eight-shot prompt and literal Answer: cue; no answer keys in runtime.

action_contract.trigger: Actual native regular waiting-queue selector with PREEMPTED head, skipped queue empty; prefix must have at least2 restoration candidates.
action_contract.candidates: First at most16 contiguous PREEMPTED requests, including head; never cross a fresh WAITING request.
action_contract.first_fit: Read-only APC and physical fixed48 queries in queue order, stop at first eligible candidate.
action_contract.minimum_known_recompute: Among eligible candidates in the same bounded prefix, minimize num_tokens minus current APC-hit tokens; stable original-position ties.
action_contract.execution: Selected object is prepended only if not head; allocation/model/preemption backend unchanged; exact queue rollback on failed allocation. All selected admissions use fixed48 gate again.
action_contract.signals: Current known sequence tokens, read-only APC hits, current free blocks and physical full-known+1 gate. No future EOS, remaining actual output, gold answer, or offline future trajectory.
action_contract.guarantee: No persistent reservation, no minimum future progress, and no infinite-stream fairness guarantee.
action_contract.join: initial_scheduler_step recorded once; call_id=scheduler_step-(initial_scheduler_step+1); identity of each native PREEMPTED attempt and final positive schedule checked separately from final request completion.

metrics: All original1024 requests: completed/failed/unfinished, correctness/EOS/caps/repetition, TTFT, flow, per-request maximum successive host token gap, token throughput, diagnostic20s/4s SLO-only and correct+SLO goodput, preemption/recomputation and per-request benefit/harm. Policy None and native None separate.

decision_rule.actual_action: Require verified selected native allocation and positive final scheduled tokens; zero reorders means no action-value result.
decision_rule.initial_qualification: A pilot signal for repetition requires at least3% lower all-request mean flow or3% higher diagnostic SLO goodput against BOTH fixed-order and first-fit controls, with output-token-rate loss no more3% and meanflow increase no more5%. Alternatively at least20% lower worst host gap with the same efficiency guardrails merits a scoped tradeoff repeat.
decision_rule.quality: Preserve/report all accuracy and termination changes; any performance signal with correctness/EOS worsening is conditional and requires separate quality/termination analysis, not a pass by filtering.
decision_rule.no_increment: If first-fit covers the minimum-recompute rule, reject independent value of the extra cost ranking in this domain.
decision_rule.negative: If whole-request outcomes do not improve despite actions, stop scaling this rule; do not tune scan limit/margin on the same outcomes to rescue it.
decision_rule.invalid: Preserve failed artifacts, distinguish native/runtime/contract failure from negative policy evidence; fix a new version only for a diagnosed implementation issue.
decision_rule.evidence_ceiling: One same-development episode per arm; no significance, causal equal-work speedup, new-input generalization or independent novelty claim.

resource_recovery: Same26GiB RAM,768MiB root disk,2GiB shm guards and inode-verified shared GPU lock.1200s total per arm, release lock during15s waits, child at most once, verify model weights each arm. Post-child lossless xz of three large logs.
resource_budget: 3 GPU episodes, prior measured per-arm wall roughly120s; approximately6min plus20% allowance excluding bounded shared-resource waits.
code_scope: Reuse existing model staging/native execution/math quality analyzer/pressure observer/paired comparator. New code only implements queue selection and joins repeated PREEMPTED events. A two-arm test would conflate eligible-backfill with cost ranking; three arms directly separate them. Existing fresh-only evidence join cannot handle multiple recoveries of the same request.
interpretation: Known simple first-fit and recovery-work ordering actions; this is an action-value test and strong-simple challenge, not a new algorithm claim.

cpu_validation.scope: Native allocation fixture, not GPU execution evidence.
